reason: The six-review calibration had one completed Sol business failure, but its fresh 180-call-per-collector comparison did not reproduce a completed Sol business failure. Keep that entire run as separate evidence and increase task difficulty.
target: After eight completed, valid-action attempts at a level, require two to six successes, including both rewards on the same task. Protocol violations, action-horizon endings and unknown outcomes do not qualify. This targets a less fragile boundary than the earlier one-failure stopping rule.
routing: Start at eight reviews. More than six successes sends calibration to nine reviews. Fewer than two successes sends it to seven reviews. Retain every attempted stage. Unknown outcomes do not qualify for the target.
future_comparison: Generate four new cases from seeds 2759000 + 100*level + index. No evaluation screening. Freeze before calls. Same 180 invocations per model and collector, two disjoint 90-call blocks.
